# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 reg-serbia phases 1-4, Serbia and the Danube Line (1371-1460). Generated by gen_serbia_danube.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 34); this line writes no monthly
# hook of its own. Order (design 3.1): start, close (after 1460.12.31, or once Serbia is gone from 1459.6.1); the world
# steps; then at most one event.
oe_smd_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_smd_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_live } } set_global_variable = oe_smd_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_smd_on } } set_variable = oe_smd_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { current_date >= 1461.1.1 NOT = { var:oe_smd_helena ?= 2 } }
                    current_date >= 1470.2.1
                    AND = { current_date >= 1459.6.1 NOT = { country_exists = c:SER } }
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_end } country_exists = c:SER } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_end value = 3 } }
            set_variable = oe_smd_off
            debug_log = "oe_smd: the line is closed (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_smd_rd_ws')|0] ws4 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_smd_rd_ws4')|0] end [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_smd_rd_end')|0])"
        }
        else = {
            oe_smd_world = yes
            oe_smd_events = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps (design 3.2): in its window each step is skipped (3) when a player or the empire's bloc is
# concerned; else it runs with 100 / months left when it can run and what it waits for has come; after the window, 2.
# phase 2: W5-W8; phase 3: W9-W12, and W11b after them (its own global oe_smd_ws_11b); phase 4: W13-W16.

    if = {

# BYZ scope, monthly, before the steps. What vanilla may undo in phase 1 (notes part 一):
# - flavor_ser.70 (1375-1453, fire_only_once) moves an empire-rank Serbia's capital from Kruševac (W2) to Skopje: put back
#   once (the event cannot come again), oe_smd_w2_cap 3; 4 when Serbia did not take it (switch CAP_GUARD = True).
# - a tributary may cancel its status (tributary.txt subject_can_cancel = yes): the month a lordship of W1 or Serbia (after
#   W4, before W6) is first seen free of the Ottomans is recorded (oe_smd_free_prilep / _dejan / _ser); nothing is undone.
# - the interregnum is first seen: its month opens W6 (oe_smd_ivr_m).
# BYZ scope. The capital guard alone (also the test button smdcap).
oe_smd_cap_guard = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_cap_undone = yes }
        c:SER = { set_capital = location:krusevac }
        if = { limit = { location:krusevac = { is_capital = yes owner ?= c:SER } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w2_cap value = 3 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w2_cap value = 4 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_cap_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
}
oe_smd_watch = {
    oe_smd_cap_guard = yes
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_smd_ws_1 ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_free_prilep } oe_smd_prilep_alive = yes global_var:oe_smd_prilep = { is_subject = no } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_free_prilep value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_smd_dejan_st ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_free_dejan } oe_smd_dejan_alive = yes global_var:oe_smd_dejan = { is_subject = no } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_free_dejan value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_smd_kosovo ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_6 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_free_ser } country_exists = c:SER oe_smd_ser_trib = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_free_ser value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ivr_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ivr_m value = var:oe_smd_m } }
    # phase 3. Hungary at war with the Ottomans from 1443.6 (W12's wait): the first month seen.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_m >= 1278 var:oe_smd_m <= 1296 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_hun_war } country_exists = c:HUN country_exists = c:TUR c:HUN = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_hun_war value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
    # .4 a (craftsmen) and W10 (the new capital) both stand: the walls go up on smederevo once, while Serbia owns it.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_craft ?= 1 global_var:oe_smd_ws_10 ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_walls_m } location:smederevo = { owner ?= c:SER } }
        location:smederevo = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_smd_walls years = 50 mode = replace } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_walls_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
    # .5 b: written off when W12 did not happen (3); repaid 12 months after W12 through the hidden worker .90 (job 52).
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_loan ?= 1 has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_12 NOT = { global_var:oe_smd_ws_12 ?= 1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_loan value = 3 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_loan ?= 1 global_var:oe_smd_ws_12 ?= 1 var:oe_smd_m >= oe_smd_repay_m }
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_job value = 52 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.90
    }
    # phase 4. Hungary at war with the Ottomans from 1448.1 (W13's wait, Second Kosovo): the first month seen.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_m >= 1333 var:oe_smd_m <= 1350 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_hun_war2 } country_exists = c:HUN country_exists = c:TUR c:HUN = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_hun_war2 value = var:oe_smd_m }
    }
}

# Country scope. A lordship built by W1 gets, in this order and before its ruler (brief B6: the ruler's title is wrong when
# the government is set after the ruler), a monarchy, the Serbian culture, the Orthodox faith and the Serbian court language.
oe_smd_lord_state = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy } } change_government_type = government_type:monarchy }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { culture = culture:serbian } } change_culture = culture:serbian }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = religion:orthodox } } change_religion = religion:orthodox }
    set_court_language = culture:serbian.dialect
}

# BYZ scope. W1 the southern lords submit (1371.10-1373.12; switch SOUTH_LORDS = True). Only while oe_smd_w1_ok holds.
# The lordship of Prilep: a dynamic country from prilep, Serbia's other places of prilep_province that it holds in hand
# (bitola, kicevo, ohrid, tetovo, florina), Marko as ruler, a truce of 10 years with Serbia, the Ottomans' tributary. Then the
# lordship of Velbužd the same way from velbuzd with kumanovo, kratovo, shtip, strumica, kocani (only where Serbia holds velbuzd: else
# oe_smd_dejan_st = 4), Konstantin as ruler. Self-check: Prilep built -> oe_smd_ws_1 = 1, else 5 (nothing depends on it);
# Velbužd 1 built, 5 failed.
oe_smd_w1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_w1_ok = yes }
        location:prilep = {
            create_country_from_location = {
                save_scope_as = oe_smd_prilep_new
                change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                change_country_type = location
                change_religion = religion:orthodox
                change_culture = culture:serbian
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new location:prilep = { owner ?= scope:oe_smd_prilep_new } }
            location:bitola = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            location:kicevo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            location:ohrid = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            location:tetovo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            location:florina = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            scope:oe_smd_prilep_new = {
                set_variable = oe_smd_lordship
                set_variable = { name = oe_smd_lord value = 1 }
                change_country_name = oe_smd_prilep_name
                change_country_adjective = oe_smd_prilep_adj
                oe_smd_lord_state = yes
                create_character = {
                    first_name = name_mark
                    female = no
                    age = 30
                    dynasty = dynasty:mrnjavcevic_dynasty
                    culture = culture:serbian
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                    save_scope_as = oe_smd_marko_s
                }
                if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_marko_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_marko_made value = 1 } }
                else = {
                    create_character = {
                        first_name = name_mark
                        female = no
                        age = 30
                        culture = culture:serbian
                        religion = religion:orthodox
                        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                        save_scope_as = oe_smd_marko_s
                    }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_marko_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_marko_made value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_marko_s }
                    set_new_ruler = scope:oe_smd_marko_s
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_c_marko value = scope:oe_smd_marko_s }
                }
                if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SER NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:SER } } add_truce_with = { target = c:SER years = 10 mutual = yes } }
                if = {
                    limit = { country_exists = c:TUR is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } }
                    make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:tributary }
                }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_prilep value = scope:oe_smd_prilep_new }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_1 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_1 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_smd_ws_1 ?= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { location:velbuzd = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } }
            location:velbuzd = {
                create_country_from_location = {
                    save_scope_as = oe_smd_dejan_new
                    change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                    change_country_type = location
                    change_religion = religion:orthodox
                    change_culture = culture:serbian
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new location:velbuzd = { owner ?= scope:oe_smd_dejan_new } }
                location:kumanovo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
                location:kratovo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
                location:shtip = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
                location:strumica = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
                location:kocani = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
                scope:oe_smd_dejan_new = {
                    set_variable = oe_smd_lordship
                    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_lord value = 2 }
                    change_country_name = oe_smd_dejan_name
                    change_country_adjective = oe_smd_dejan_adj
                    oe_smd_lord_state = yes
                    create_character = {
                        first_name = name_constantine
                        female = no
                        age = 25
                        dynasty = dynasty:dejanovic_dynasty
                        culture = culture:serbian
                        religion = religion:orthodox
                        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                        save_scope_as = oe_smd_konstantin_s
                    }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_konstantin_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_konstantin_made value = 1 } }
                    else = {
                        create_character = {
                            first_name = name_constantine
                            female = no
                            age = 25
                            culture = culture:serbian
                            religion = religion:orthodox
                            estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                            save_scope_as = oe_smd_konstantin_s
                        }
                        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_konstantin_s } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_konstantin_made value = 2 } }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_konstantin_s }
                        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_smd_konstantin_s
                        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_c_konstantin value = scope:oe_smd_konstantin_s }
                    }
                    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SER NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:SER } } add_truce_with = { target = c:SER years = 10 mutual = yes } }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } }
                        make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:tributary }
                    }
                }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_dejan value = scope:oe_smd_dejan_new }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_dejan_st value = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_dejan_st value = 5 } }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_dejan_st value = 4 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W2 Prince Lazar (1372.1-1374.12; switch LAZAR_RULER = False). Serbia gets oe_smd_morava for
# 10 years; its capital moves to Kruševac where Serbia holds it in hand (global oe_smd_w2_cap = 1 when it is
# the capital afterwards).
oe_smd_w2 = {
    c:SER = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_smd_morava years = 10 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { location:krusevac = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } } c:SER = { set_capital = location:krusevac } }
    if = { limit = { location:krusevac = { is_capital = yes owner ?= c:SER } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w2_cap value = 1 } }
    # LAZAR_RULER is off: Lazar is not made ruler (design 六.3)
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_2 value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. W3 Niš (1385.6-1387.12). Niš and Prokuplje pass from Serbia to the Ottomans where Serbia holds them in hand
# (never a capital, never under siege); a truce of 5 years. Self-check: Niš is the Ottomans' -> 1, else 5.
oe_smd_w3 = {
    location:nis = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
    location:prokuplje = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:nis = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
        c:SER = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 5 mutual = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_3 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_3 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W4 Kosovo (1389.6-1390.12). The roll oe_smd_kos_chance (Serbia does not submit; the test buttons smdw4a /
# smdw4b fix it once through oe_smd_force: 1 submits, 2 does not). Not submitted: Serbia's stability and prestige
# (oe_smd_kosovo = 2). Submitted (history): the Ottomans' tributary (where Serbia is nobody's subject) and a truce of
# 10 years (oe_smd_kosovo = 1; oe_smd_ws_4 = 5 when Serbia is not their subject afterwards). Either way
# oe_smd_vidovdan for 20 years, and the month for .2 (global oe_smd_w4_m).
oe_smd_w4 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_kos_at value = oe_smd_kos_chance }
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_smd_force } c:SER = { is_subject = no } }
        random = { chance = oe_smd_kos_chance set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_force } remove_variable = oe_smd_force }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_roll = 1 }
        c:SER = { add_stability = stability_weak_bonus add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_kosovo value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_4 value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { c:SER = { is_subject = no } } c:SER = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:tributary } } }
        c:SER = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_kosovo value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { c:SER = { is_subject_of = c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_4 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_4 value = 5 } }
    }
    c:SER = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_smd_vidovdan years = 20 mode = replace } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w4_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
    remove_variable = oe_smd_roll
}

# ---- phase 2 (1390-1427)
# BYZ scope. W5 Prilep and Velbužd annexed (1395.3-1396.12; after Rovine or from 1395.12). Each W1 lordship that still fits
# (oe_smd_lord_fit_<k>: AI, outside the bloc, nobody's subject but the Ottomans', at peace with them) is annexed by the
# Ottomans in peace. Where it still exists afterwards (a tributary is can_be_annexed = no in vanilla; whether the effect
# heeds it was not seen), every place it holds in hand passes to the Ottomans, its capital last, and the country is gone.
# Self-check: a lordship was fitting and is gone now -> 1, else 5.
oe_smd_w5 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_w5_n value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_lord_fit_prilep = yes }
        global_var:oe_smd_prilep = { save_scope_as = oe_smd_lp }
        scope:oe_smd_lp = { every_owned_location = { set_variable = oe_smd_settle } }
        c:TUR = { annex_country = { country = scope:oe_smd_lp reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
        c:TUR = { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:TUR } change_integration_level = core } } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = scope:oe_smd_lp }
            scope:oe_smd_lp = {
                every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle }
                every_owned_location = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_smd_lp has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
                capital ?= { if = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_smd_lp has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = scope:oe_smd_lp } } change_variable = { name = oe_smd_w5_n add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_lord_fit_dejan = yes }
        global_var:oe_smd_dejan = { save_scope_as = oe_smd_lp }
        scope:oe_smd_lp = { every_owned_location = { set_variable = oe_smd_settle } }
        c:TUR = { annex_country = { country = scope:oe_smd_lp reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
        c:TUR = { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:TUR } change_integration_level = core } } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = scope:oe_smd_lp }
            scope:oe_smd_lp = {
                every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle }
                every_owned_location = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_smd_lp has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
                capital ?= { if = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_smd_lp has_siege = no } change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = scope:oe_smd_lp } } change_variable = { name = oe_smd_w5_n add = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_w5_n > 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_5 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_5 value = 5 } }
    remove_variable = oe_smd_w5_n
}
# BYZ scope. W6 after Ankara (the 18 months after oe_ivr_begun is first seen). Serbia the Ottomans' subject: released
# (cancel_subject, as gen_beyliks.py W-9a), a truce of 10 years; oe_smd_w6_how 1. Already free (it cancelled the
# tributary itself): only recorded, oe_smd_w6_how 2. Either way, where Serbia's ruler is the empire's despot,
# oe_smd_despotate for 30 years. Self-check: still the Ottomans' subject after the release -> 5.
oe_smd_w6 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_ser_trib = yes }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:SER }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_smd_ser_trib = no }
            c:SER = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w6_how value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_6 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_6 value = 5 } }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w6_how value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_6 value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_smd_ws_6 ?= 1 oe_smd_ser_despot = yes }
        c:SER = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_smd_despotate years = 30 mode = replace } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W7 Belgrade (1403.6-1405.12, after W6). Belgrade first (the Reich's all-or-nothing order: the rest only when
# the key piece has passed): from Hungary, held in hand, with the cores as vanilla's flavor_hun_ser.1002 moves them
# (oe_smd_w7_how 1); or Serbia already owns it (vanilla's deal came first: how 2, no payment of ours, vanilla's yearly
# 3 gold goes on). Then Hungary's places of Mačva (sabac, debrc) held in hand, the same way; Serbia's capital to
# Belgrade; Serbia's opinion of Hungary (oe_smd_b_sigismund); Hungary's one-way protection (switch PROTECTION = True,
# only while Serbia is nobody's subject: the relation ends when it becomes one). Self-check: Serbia owns Belgrade -> 1, else 5.
oe_smd_w7 = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:belgrad = { owner ?= c:HUN controller ?= c:HUN has_siege = no is_capital = no } }
        location:belgrad = {
            change_location_owner = c:SER change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:HUN } remove_core = c:HUN }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = c:SER } } add_core = c:SER }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:belgrad = { owner ?= c:SER } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w7_how value = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { location:belgrad = { owner ?= c:SER } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w7_how value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:belgrad = { owner ?= c:SER } }
        location:sabac = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:HUN controller ?= c:HUN has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:SER change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:HUN } remove_core = c:HUN } if = { limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = c:SER } } add_core = c:SER } } }
        location:debrc = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:HUN controller ?= c:HUN has_siege = no is_capital = no } change_location_owner = c:SER change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:HUN } remove_core = c:HUN } if = { limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = c:SER } } add_core = c:SER } } }
        if = { limit = { location:belgrad = { is_capital = no } } c:SER = { set_capital = location:belgrad } }
        c:SER = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_smd_b_sigismund target = c:HUN } }
        if = {
            limit = { c:SER = { is_subject = no } c:HUN = { is_subject = no } }
            c:SER = { set_variable = oe_smd_protected }
            create_relation = { type = relation_type:oe_smd_rel_protection first = c:HUN second = c:SER }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_7 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_7 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W8 Zeta's testament (1421.1-1422.12): Serbia annexes Zeta in peace. Self-check: Zeta is gone -> 1, else 5.
oe_smd_w8 = {
    c:ZTA = { every_owned_location = { set_variable = oe_smd_settle } }
    c:SER = { annex_country = { country = c:ZTA reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    c:SER = { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:SER } change_integration_level = core } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ZTA } c:ZTA = { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle } } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:ZTA } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_8 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_8 value = 5 } }
}

# ---- phase 3 (1427-1444). Every change of owner goes through oe_smd_hand (common/scripted_effects/oe_smd_hand.txt), which settles
# the place on its new owner (decision 296).
# BYZ scope. W9 Belgrade back to Hungary (1427.7-1428.12; only the Belgrade that came by W7). Serbia's capital leaves
# Belgrade first: to smederevo where Serbia holds it in hand, else to its most populous place under its control without a siege.
# Then Belgrade, held in hand, passes to Hungary with the cores (vanilla's flavor_hun_ser.1002 lines, reversed); Hungary's
# protection of W7 ends (switch W9_UNPROTECT = True; Praecepta Militaria Danube 1.4 pmpd_pact_end's form: the marker
# first, the relation where it is still given). Self-check: Hungary owns Belgrade -> 1, else 5. Global oe_smd_w9_m: the month.
oe_smd_w9 = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:belgrad = { is_capital = yes owner ?= c:SER } }
        if = { limit = { location:smederevo = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } } c:SER = { set_capital = location:smederevo } }
        else = {
            c:SER = { ordered_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no NOT = { this = location:belgrad } } order_by = population max = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_smd_cap9 } }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_cap9 } c:SER = { set_capital = scope:oe_smd_cap9 } }
        }
    }
    location:belgrad = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:HUN } if = { limit = { is_core_of = c:SER } remove_core = c:SER } if = { limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = c:HUN } } add_core = c:HUN } } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:belgrad = { owner ?= c:HUN } }
        c:SER = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_protected } remove_variable = oe_smd_protected } }
        if = {
            limit = { c:HUN = { giving_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:oe_smd_rel_protection target = c:SER } } }
            remove_relation = { type = relation_type:oe_smd_rel_protection first = c:HUN second = c:SER }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_9 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_9 value = 5 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w9_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
}
# BYZ scope. W10 the new capital (the 24 months after W9 is recorded): Serbia's capital to smederevo. Self-check: it is the
# capital -> 1, else 5. The walls of .4 a follow in oe_smd_watch once this stands.
oe_smd_w10 = {
    if = { limit = { location:smederevo = { is_capital = no } } c:SER = { set_capital = location:smederevo } }
    if = { limit = { location:smederevo = { is_capital = yes owner ?= c:SER } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_10 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_10 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W11 the siege of smederevo (1439.5-1439.12). The roll oe_smd_smd_chance (the city HOLDS; the test buttons smdw11a /
# smdw11b fix it once through oe_smd_force: 1 it falls, 2 it holds). Held: the Ottomans' opinion of Serbia
# (oe_smd_b_held), oe_smd_fall39 2. Fell (history), oe_smd_fall39 1: where Serbia holds a place of Zeta in hand, its capital
# moves to the most populous one (when the capital lay in serbia_area outside Zeta), then every place of serbia_area Serbia
# holds in hand passes to the Ottomans but Zeta and novo_brdo (W11b); self-check: the Ottomans own smederevo -> 1, else 5. No
# place in Zeta: the Ottomans annex Serbia in peace (design 3.2); where Serbia still exists afterwards (a tributary is
# can_be_annexed = no), every place it holds in hand passes, its capital last, as W5's fallback; self-check: Serbia is gone
# -> 1 (oe_smd_ser_gone 1), else 5. Global oe_smd_w11_m: the month (.5 and W11b count from it).
oe_smd_w11 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_smd_at value = oe_smd_smd_chance }
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_smd_force } }
        random = { chance = oe_smd_smd_chance set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_force } remove_variable = oe_smd_force }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_roll = 1 }
        c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_smd_b_held target = c:SER } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_fall39 value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11 value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_fall39 value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_smd_ser_zeta = yes }
            c:SER = { ordered_owned_location = { limit = { province_definition = province_definition:zeta_province controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no } order_by = population max = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_smd_zcap } }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_smd_zcap c:SER = { capital ?= { area = area:serbia_area NOT = { province_definition = province_definition:zeta_province } } } }
                c:SER = { set_capital = scope:oe_smd_zcap }
            }
            area:serbia_area = { every_location_in_area = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no NOT = { province_definition = province_definition:zeta_province } NOT = { this = location:novo_brdo } } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } } }
            if = { limit = { location:smederevo = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11 value = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11 value = 5 } }
        }
        else = {
            oe_smd_annex = { by = c:TUR who = c:SER }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:SER }
                c:SER = {
                    every_owned_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } }
                    capital ?= { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } } }
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:SER } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ser_gone value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11 value = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11 value = 5 } }
        }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w11_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
    remove_variable = oe_smd_roll
}
# BYZ scope. W11b novo_brdo (18-30 months after the fall): to the Ottomans, held in hand. Self-check: theirs -> 1, else 5.
oe_smd_w11b = {
    location:novo_brdo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } } }
    if = { limit = { location:novo_brdo = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11b value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_11b value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W12 the peace of Szeged (1444.6-1444.12, after the fall). smederevo first, from the Ottomans' hand (it wakes Serbia
# when Serbia is gone: r20 probe 10; oe_smd_w12_how 1 woken, 2 enlarged); the rest only when smederevo reached Serbia (the
# Reich's all-or-nothing order: nothing else moves otherwise): krusevac, rudnik, kucevo, branicevo, novo_brdo, each held in hand by the Ottomans;
# then Serbia's capital smederevo, the Ottomans' tributary (where Serbia is nobody's subject), a truce of 10 years,
# Serbia's opinion of Hungary (oe_smd_b_szeged). Self-check: Serbia owns smederevo -> 1, else 5. Global oe_smd_w12_m: the month.
oe_smd_w12 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SER } set_variable = oe_smd_had_ser }
    location:smederevo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:SER } } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:smederevo = { owner ?= c:SER } }
        location:krusevac = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:SER } } }
        location:rudnik = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:SER } } }
        location:kucevo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:SER } } }
        location:branicevo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:SER } } }
        location:novo_brdo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:SER } } }
        c:SER = {
            if = { limit = { location:smederevo = { is_capital = no } } set_capital = location:smederevo }
            if = { limit = { is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:tributary } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_smd_b_szeged target = c:HUN }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_had_ser } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w12_how value = 2 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w12_how value = 1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w12_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_12 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_12 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_had_ser } remove_variable = oe_smd_had_ser }
}
# BYZ scope. The hidden worker .90, job 52 (.5 b): Serbia, still there and AI, repays 2 months of the empire's
# income (oe_smd_repay) out of its treasury: all of it -> oe_smd_loan 2; what it has when that is less (above 0) -> 4;
# nothing, or Serbia gone or a player's -> 3. Gold only moves from Serbia to the empire, never the other way.
oe_smd_job_52 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_ser_ai = yes }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_smd_due value = oe_smd_repay }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_smd_due > 0 c:SER = { gold >= scope:oe_smd_due } }
            c:SER = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_smd_due multiply = -1 } }
            add_gold = scope:oe_smd_due
            set_variable = { name = oe_smd_loan value = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { c:SER = { gold > 0 } }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_smd_part value = c:SER.gold }
            c:SER = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_smd_part multiply = -1 } }
            add_gold = scope:oe_smd_part
            set_variable = { name = oe_smd_loan value = 4 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_loan value = 3 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_loan value = 3 } }
}

# ---- phase 4 (1444-1460). Every change of owner goes through oe_smd_hand, and peaceful annexation through oe_smd_annex
# (common/scripted_effects/oe_smd_hand.txt), settling every AI-to-AI handover (decision 296 / 296-1).
# BYZ scope. W13 Hunyadi detained (1448.9-1449.6): opinion only (Hungary of Serbia -30); no land moves.
oe_smd_w13 = {
    c:HUN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_smd_b_detained target = c:SER } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_13 value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. W14 novo_brdo falls again (1455.3-1455.12): to the Ottomans, held in hand, settled via oe_smd_hand.
oe_smd_w14 = {
    location:novo_brdo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } } }
    if = { limit = { location:novo_brdo = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_14 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_14 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W15 the siege of Belgrade (1456.6-1456.9). The roll oe_smd_bel_chance (Belgrade HOLDS; test buttons smdw15a /
# smdw15b fix it once through oe_smd_force: 2 holds, 1 falls). Held (history): oe_smd_bel_failed on the Ottomans for
# 10 years, Hunyadi is NOT killed (design 六.8), oe_smd_belgrade = 1. Fell: Belgrade passes to
# the Ottomans via oe_smd_hand, 5y truce, oe_smd_belgrade = 2.
oe_smd_w15 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_bel_at value = oe_smd_bel_chance }
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_smd_force } }
        random = { chance = oe_smd_bel_chance set_variable = { name = oe_smd_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_force } remove_variable = oe_smd_force }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_roll = 1 }
        c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_smd_bel_failed years = 10 mode = replace } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_belgrade value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_15 value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        location:belgrad = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:HUN controller ?= c:HUN has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_belgrade value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { location:belgrad = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            c:HUN = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 5 mutual = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_15 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_15 value = 5 } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w15_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
    remove_variable = oe_smd_roll
}
# BYZ scope. W16 the gates of smederevo (1459.3-1460.6, or 1468.1-1469.12 when .7 b was chosen): the Ottomans annex Serbia in
# peace via oe_smd_annex (settled); where Serbia still exists afterwards (a tributary is can_be_annexed = no), every place it
# holds in hand passes via oe_smd_hand, capital last (same fallback as W11). Self-check: Serbia is gone -> oe_smd_end 1 (normal)
# or 2 (after .7 b deferral), oe_smd_ws_16 = 1; else 5. Vanilla flavor_hun.220 can then follow naturally.
oe_smd_w16 = {
    oe_smd_annex = { by = c:TUR who = c:SER }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SER }
        c:SER = {
            every_owned_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } }
            capital ?= { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no } oe_smd_hand = { to = c:TUR } } }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:SER } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_helena ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_end value = 2 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_end value = 1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_16 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_ws_16 value = 5 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_smd_w16_m value = var:oe_smd_m }
}
# BYZ scope. The hidden worker .90, job 71 (.7 b): if Serbia and the Ottomans are both AI, outside the empire's bloc, at
# peace, and Serbia is nobody's subject, make Serbia the Ottomans' tributary (design 3.4).
oe_smd_job_71 = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_smd_ott_ok = yes oe_smd_ser_ai = yes
            c:SER = { is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } }
        }
        c:SER = { make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:tributary } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events (design 3.3): lapse, then at most one; each waits for the lock and for calm.
oe_smd_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_1 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_2 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_3 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_4 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_5 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_6 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_gone_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_7 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_late_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_7 value = 2 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 2 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 3 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 4 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 6 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_smd_calm = yes oe_smd_ok_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_smd_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_smd_pick value = 7 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 1 } oe_smd_send_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 2 } oe_smd_send_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 3 } oe_smd_send_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 4 } oe_smd_send_4 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 5 } oe_smd_send_5 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 6 } oe_smd_send_6 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_smd_pick = 7 } oe_smd_send_7 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_smd_pick
}

# BYZ scope. The sender of each event: its state (st 1) and the event. The monthly check and the test buttons both use it,
# so a button shows the event exactly as the month would (.6 stores oe_smd_bel_odds before firing, design 3.3 / 4.5).
oe_smd_send_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.1 }
oe_smd_send_2 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.2 }
oe_smd_send_3 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.3 }
oe_smd_send_4 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_4 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.4 }
oe_smd_send_5 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_5 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 5 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.5 }
oe_smd_send_6 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_6 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 6 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_bel_odds value = oe_smd_bel_chance } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.6 }
oe_smd_send_7 = { set_variable = { name = oe_smd_st_7 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_smd_last value = 7 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.7 }

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month).
oe_smd_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. Show an event now through its sender: the date, the chance, the lock and calm are left out; the event's own
# trigger is still checked.
oe_smd_test_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_ev_1 = yes } oe_smd_send_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: .1 cannot be shown (Serbia or the Ottomans gone, a player's, or on the empire's side)" }
}
oe_smd_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_ev_2 = yes } oe_smd_send_2 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: .2 cannot be shown (Kosovo has not been rolled: press smdw4a or smdw4b first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Run a world step now, the window, the chance and the waits aside (its record is overwritten). W1, W2: their
# full condition (oe_smd_w<n>_ok) is still checked. W3, W4: the border and the army size are left out (in a 1337 game the
# Ottomans do not border Serbia); the rest is checked.
oe_smd_test_w1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_w1_ok = yes } oe_smd_w1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W1 cannot run (Serbia and the Ottomans must be AI, outside the empire's side and at peace with each other; Uros V must not rule Serbia; Serbia must hold and control Prilep, not its capital, no siege; no lordship of Prilep yet)" }
}
oe_smd_test_w2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_w2_ok = yes } oe_smd_w2_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W2 cannot run (Serbia must be AI and outside the empire's side; Lazar alive, in Serbia, not its ruler)" }
}
oe_smd_test_w3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_ott_ok = yes oe_smd_ser_ai = yes NOT = { c:SER = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } location:nis = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = no } }
        oe_smd_w3_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W3 cannot run (Serbia and the Ottomans must be AI, outside the empire's side and at peace with each other; Serbia must hold and control Nis, no siege, not its capital)" }
}
# BYZ scope. W4 with the roll fixed: $r$ = 1 Serbia submits, 2 it does not.
oe_smd_test_w4 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_ott_ok = yes oe_smd_ser_ai = yes NOT = { c:SER = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } c:SER = { OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = c:TUR } } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_force value = $r$ }
        oe_smd_w4_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W4 cannot run (Serbia and the Ottomans must be AI, outside the empire's side and at peace with each other; Serbia nobody's subject but the Ottomans')" }
}

# BYZ scope. Do what vanilla's flavor_ser.70 would (Serbia's capital to Skopje, where W2 had moved it to Kruševac and
# Serbia holds Skopje), then the guard once, the month aside.
oe_smd_test_cap = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_smd_w2_cap ?= 1 oe_smd_ser_ai = yes location:skopje = { owner ?= c:SER is_capital = no } location:krusevac = { owner ?= c:SER controller ?= c:SER has_siege = no is_capital = yes } }
        c:SER = { set_capital = location:skopje }
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = 457 }
        oe_smd_cap_guard = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: the capital guard cannot be tried (press smdw2 first: Krusevac must be Serbia's capital by W2, Serbia must hold Skopje and be AI)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state and its modifiers on Serbia (what the world steps changed stays: the lordships,
# the places, the overlordship).

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_6 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_6 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_7 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_7 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_8 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_8 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_9 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_9 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_10 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_11 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_11 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_12 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_12 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_13 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_13 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_14 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_14 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_15 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_15 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_16 } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_ws_16 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_marko_made } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_marko_made }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_konstantin_made } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_konstantin_made }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_c_marko } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_c_marko }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_smd_c_konstantin } remove_global_variable = oe_smd_c_konstantin }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SER }
        c:SER = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_smd_morava } remove_country_modifier = oe_smd_morava }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_smd_vidovdan } remove_country_modifier = oe_smd_vidovdan }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_smd_despotate } remove_country_modifier = oe_smd_despotate }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_protected } remove_variable = oe_smd_protected }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
        c:TUR = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_smd_bel_failed } remove_country_modifier = oe_smd_bel_failed }
        }
    }
    location:smederevo = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_smd_walls } remove_location_modifier = oe_smd_walls } }
}
# ---- phase 3 test buttons. W9, W10, W12 above (TEST_WHY: each step's own condition; W12's wait, the Long Campaign, is
# skipped like every wait). W11 with the roll fixed ($r$ = 1 the city falls, 2 it holds); the border, the army size and
# Hungary's war are left out (in a 1337 game the Ottomans do not border Serbia), the rest is checked.
oe_smd_test_w11 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_ott_ok = yes oe_smd_ser_ai = yes NOT = { c:SER = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } location:smederevo = { owner ?= c:SER } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_force value = $r$ }
        oe_smd_w11_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W11 cannot run (Serbia and the Ottomans must be AI, outside the empire's side and at peace with each other; Serbia must own Smederevo)" }
}
oe_smd_test_w11b = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_w11b_ok = yes } oe_smd_w11b_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W11b cannot run (Smederevo must have fallen: press smdw11a; Serbia and the Ottomans AI, outside the empire's side, at peace; Serbia holds Novo Brdo, no siege)" }
}
oe_smd_test_4 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_ev_4 = yes } oe_smd_send_4 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: .4 cannot be shown (Serbia must be AI, outside the empire's side, and own Smederevo)" }
}
oe_smd_test_5 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_smd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_smd_ev_5 = yes } oe_smd_send_5 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: .5 cannot be shown (Smederevo has not fallen: press smdw11a first)" }
}
# BYZ scope (fix-g1222 item 17). W7's last clause in a 1337 test game: Hungary's opinion of Serbia starts below 0 (r23
# g20 needed oe_smd_b_szeged three times); where it is below 0, Hungary gets the test opinion oe_smd_b_test_hun of Serbia
# (+100, 1 year). Nothing else of W7 is touched; then press smdw7.
oe_smd_test_hunop = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:HUN country_exists = c:SER }
        c:HUN = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { opinion = { target = c:SER value >= 0 } } }
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_smd_b_test_hun target = c:SER }
            }
        }
        debug_log = "oe_smd test: Hungary has a test opinion of Serbia of +100 where it was below 0 (W7's last clause); press smdw7"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: Hungary or Serbia does not exist" }
}
# BYZ scope. The repayment of .5 b now, the 12 months aside (only after .5 b was chosen and W12 ran).
oe_smd_test_repay = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_smd_loan ?= 1 global_var:oe_smd_ws_12 ?= 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_smd_job value = 52 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_smd.90
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: no loan to repay (press smdw11a, smd5 and choose b, then smdw12)" }
}
# ---- phase 4 test buttons.
# W13: leaves out date, Hunyadi alive and war record (1337 save has no Hunyadi yet); checks HUN & SER AI and at peace.

    if = {
        limit = { oe_smd_hun_ai = yes oe_smd_ser_ai = yes NOT = { c:HUN = { is_at_war_with = c:SER } } }
        oe_smd_w13_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W13 cannot run (Hungary and Serbia must be AI, outside the empire's side and at peace)" }
}

        oe_smd_w14_run = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_smd test: W14 cannot run (Serbia and the Ottomans must be AI, outside the empire's side and at peace; Serbia must hold Novo Brdo in hand)" }
